content.text:
I've submitted the campaign with **index 2 (Sb fraction 0.097)** as the best composition, at **0.069% EQE**. That value is very low in absolute terms, and I can't tell how close it is to the true best on the line.

All 5 EQE measurements are used; I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so no phases were confirmed.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.082 | −0.0013 |
| **2** | **0.097** | **0.069** |
| 5 | 0.130 | −0.0006 |
| 11 | 0.234 | 0.0007 |
| 21 | 0.505 | ≈0 |

- **Why this result is plausible:** the known La–Sb–O compounds are expected to have band gaps wider than the 2.4 eV illumination, so near-zero EQE along most of the line is not surprising.
- **What the peak might be:** index 2 is the only point with a real signal, and both its neighbours read about zero. So the response looks like a narrow feature, maybe from defects or a minor second phase — that's a guess, and I didn't run XRD to check.
- **What I didn't test:** the peak could be sharper on either side of index 2 (indices 1, 3 or 4), and everything above Sb 0.51 is unmeasured. I spent the last two measurements on indices 0 and 5, on either side of index 2, and neither turned up a higher value.
